fact_english: The jade vine, native to the Philippines, has turquoise-blue flowers, a colour very rare in plants, and is pollinated by bats.
source_onscreen: Pinagmulan: Wikipedia; University of Bristol news

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: May baging sa Pilipinas, ang jade vine, na kulay turkesa ang bulaklak. Bihirang kulay iyan sa halaman.

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: At paniki ang dumadalaw sa bulaklak niya sa gabi. Tahimik na trabaho.

after_text: Ang batang nakita namin sa Calamba, tatlumpu't limang taong gulang na.
why_here: After the reveal that Pepe is now thirty-five, before the procedure of the execution begins; never inside it. Grave episode: gentle nature fact and a mild joke.
